---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(lubridate)
workout_log = read.csv("Workout Log.csv")
```


```{r}
workout_log |>
  filter(Workout == "Ppl X Arnold (Push)") |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Weight, x = Reps, color = Exercise)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Push Day Execrises", 
       subtitle = "Info: it displays each Execrises reps and the amount of weight I do during this day")
```





```{r}
workout_log |>
  filter(Workout == "Ppl X Arnold (Push)") |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Weight, x = factor(Reps), color = Exercise)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) + 
   facet_wrap(~ Exercise, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)) + 
 labs(title = "Spread of Weight and Repetitions per Push Day Execrise over Two Weeks", 
       subtitle = "Heavier weights usually alings with fewer repetitions across most push execrises",
       caption = "Author: Luis Gonzalez-Xochihua | Date: 11/17/26 | Source: MacroFactor App",
       x = "Repetitions per Set (Reps)",
       y = "Weight (lbs)",
       color = "Execrise") +
  theme_minimal()  +
  theme(
       plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
```
